'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Haitian crisis (2018–present)|Haitian crisis]]
**The [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]] [[airlift]]s non-essential personnel from the U.S. embassy in [[Port-au-Prince]], [[Haiti]], amid [[Gang war in Haiti|escalating violence]] in the country. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us-military-airlifts-embassy-personnel-haiti-bolsters-security-2024-03-10/ (Reuters)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[96th Academy Awards]]
**''[[Oppenheimer (film)|Oppenheimer]]'' wins an [[Academy Awards|Oscar]] for [[Academy Award for Best Picture|Best Picture]]. Director Christopher Nolan wins [[Academy Award for Best Director]], and lead actor [[Cillian Murphy]] wins [[Academy Award for Best Actor|the Best Actor award]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/film/2024/mar/10/oscars-best-picture-oppenheimer (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.nbcnews.com/pop-culture/awards/christopher-nolan-oppenheimer-best-picture-oscar-win-rcna142530 (NBC News)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/entertainment-arts-68530809 (BBC News)]
**''[[20 Days in Mariupol]]'' (directed by filmmaker [[Mstyslav Chernov]]), a documentary that focuses on the [[siege of Mariupol]] during the [[Russian invasion of Ukraine]], wins an [[Academy Awards|Oscar]] for [[Academy Award for Best Documentary Feature Film|Best Documentary]]. [https://amp.theguardian.com/film/2024/mar/11/20-days-in-mariupol-documentary-oscar (''The Guardian'')]
*The painting ''[[Head of an Old Farmer's Wife in a White Hat]]'' by [[Vincent van Gogh]] is sold at auction for more than [[€]]4.5 million. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2512228-schilderij-van-gogh-op-kunstbeurs-tefaf-verkocht-voor-ruim-4-5-miljoen-euro (NOS)]

*Five people are killed after an [[Gulfstream G100|IAI Astra 1125]] [[business jet|private jet]] crashes near [[Hot Springs, Virginia]], [[United States]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/virginia-plane-crash-deaths-b2510688.html (''The Independent'')]
*One [[skier]] is killed and two others are injured after falling in [[Mount Washington]] in [[New Hampshire]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/new-hampshire-tuckerman-ravine-rescue-0b5e8954f38c6fa68cef0220b0b78172 (AP)]
